visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white engraving depicting a group of people in a wooded, riverine setting. A man in buckskin clothing stands in the water, holding a long pole and steadying a small wooden canoe. Inside the canoe, a woman is seated, reaching out to take the hand of another woman who is being assisted by a man in a military-style uniform. A fourth man, wearing a tricorn hat, stands on the riverbank near a tree, observing the scene. The style is that of a 19th-century book illustration.
